summary: I read all 15 frames, and the same man is clearly in the shot in every one of them. The camera, the room and his clothes stay the same from 2:54 to 40:25. No frame is empty, and he is never lying down, asleep or absorbed in a phone. A few frames are slightly soft or blurred, but he is still easy to recognize, so none of them needed an 'ambiguous' verdict. He was present for the whole sampled session.
